title: Ex-Rockstar Boss Dan Houser Won't Play GTA 6 and Avoids Open-World Games
description: Former Rockstar boss and GTA creative director Dan Houser reveals he doesn't play open-world games and won't play GTA 6, all for creative reasons at Absurd Ventures.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Why Former Rockstar Boss Dan Houser Won't Play GTA 6

For fans eagerly anticipating the launch of *GTA 6*, a recent revelation from industry veteran Dan Houser might come as a surprise. The former co-boss of Rockstar Games and the creative director behind the *Grand Theft Auto* series has stated that he doesn't play many open-world games—and he has no plans to play *GTA 6* either.

As one of the key masterminds behind some of the most influential open-world franchises in gaming history, Houser's detachment from the genre he helped define is certainly noteworthy. However, this decision is not born out of indifference, but rather from a very deliberate creative strategy as he builds his new venture, Absurd Ventures.

## Protecting Creative Vision at Absurd Ventures

According to the source, Houser's choice to avoid open-world games and steer clear of *GTA 6* stems from a solid creative reason: he does not want his work on his two new game projects at Absurd Ventures to be influenced by them.

In the competitive landscape of game development, top-tier creators often guard their creative processes fiercely. Immersing oneself in contemporary titles—especially massive projects like *GTA 6*—can inadvertently lead to design convergence or subconscious bias. By deliberately stepping away from open-world games, Houser is ensuring that his upcoming projects at Absurd Ventures maintain a distinct, unpolluted creative voice.

## Looking Ahead to New Horizons

Ever since his departure from Rockstar Games, Houser's next moves have been closely monitored by the gaming community. While players continue to look forward to the eventual release of *GTA 6*, Houser is entirely focused on the future. His commitment to avoiding outside influences demonstrates a rigorous approach to building entirely new universes from scratch.

Whether Absurd Ventures can replicate the cultural impact of his previous work remains to be seen, but his uncompromising dedication to pure originality is a promising sign for his future titles.

## Editor's Take

Dan Houser's refusal to play *GTA 6* highlights the mindset of a true visionary. By actively shielding himself from the gravitational pull of his past masterpieces, he is clearing the mental space needed to truly innovate at Absurd Ventures. It's a bold and admirable stance on creative integrity.
